sentences.text:
For the Appellant/s : Mr. Rajendra Prasad Sah, Advocate
 For the Respondent/s : Mr. Zeyaul Hoda, App

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
9 13-03-2024 Re.: I.A. No.05 of 2023 Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned APP for the State on the aforesaid I.A. for consideration of prayer for bail and suspension of sentence.
2. This is the fourth attempt of the appellant before this Court for grant of bail and suspension of sentence.
3. Conviction has been recorded under Section 304B and 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant inter alia submits that appellant is in custody for more than six years and six months and there is no likelihood that this appeal may be taken up for hearing.

5. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.1228 of 2018(9) dt.13-03-2024 case as well as the fact that the appellant is in custody for more than 6 years, let the appellant, above named, during pendency of this appeal, be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.25,000.00 (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court No.2, Katihar in connection with Sessions Trial No.325 of 2011/47 of 2012, arising out of Barsoi P.S. Case No.44 of 2011, subject to deposit of fine as awarded by the learned Trial Court as Md. Mister vs The State Of Bihar on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141178831/
1 part of sentence.
6.
